sources.title: GitHub - dokterkepin/nxp_omniman_ws: Omnidirectional Mecanum Mobile ...
sources.snippet: A ROS 2 Humble mobile manipulator featuring a mecanum-wheeled base with a 6-DOF arm and gripper. The robot uses CyberGear motors (base + arm), Dynamixel servos (wrist + gripper), and an RPLidar for SLAM and navigation.

sources.title: Models - opencode.ai
sources.snippet: Here the full ID is provider_id/model_id. For example, if you're using OpenCode Zen, you would use opencode/gpt-5.1-codex for GPT 5.1 Codex. If you've configured a custom provider, the provider_id is key from the provider part of your config, and the model_id is the key from provider.models.
